purpose: Private active-case shadow package for Shelly Kittleson based on public-source bounded anchors only

public_facts.notes: CPJ says she was kidnapped in broad daylight on March 31, 2026 while waiting roadside on Saadoun Street; a friend met her about an hour earlier and said the embassy warned her of militia threats.

AP says she remains missing, authorities believe she is still in Baghdad, one suspect was arrested after a chase/crash, and U.S. officials alleged Kataib Hezbollah involvement while stressing prior warnings.
Shafaq timestamps a local report at 19:55:50 Baghdad time and places the seizure near the Palestine Hotel on Al-Saadoun Street.
964media published at 19:37 Baghdad time and described an armed group in black uniforms carrying out the abduction near the Palestine Hotel on Saadoun Street.
Broadcast relay says CCTV shows cars blocking her path, kidnappers dragging her into a vehicle, and transfer into another car, but no verifiable on-screen timecode is visible in the public copy.
CJR says CFWIJ saw footage confirming broad-daylight seizure by men who did not conceal themselves and that a person had asked her to wait outside a hotel entrance, suggesting a setup.
